newsitem.title: UK: S&P removes Banque Sovac Immobilier from watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P removes Banque Sovac Immobilier from watch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it affirmed its AA minus long-term and A1 plus short-term ratings of Banque Sovac Immobilier (BSI) and removed them from CreditWatch where they were placed February 29, 1996.
"The outlook on BSI's long-term rating remains developing," S&P said in a statement.

"This decision reflects the absence of any potential buyer for BSI at the time of writing, though ongoing uncertainties surrounding BSI's continued membership of the Sovac group remain," the agency said.

"The developing outlook reflects the ongoing uncertainties surrounding BSI's continued membership of the Sovac group, fully controlled by General Electric Capital Corp," S&P said adding that GE Capital was rated AAA/A1 plus.
S&P said the following ratings had been affirmed and removed from creditwatch.
Short-term certificates of deposit A1 plus
